selection: For each family: first highest number of development requests meeting both unchanged physical gates, then lower worst mean-free pressure error, then stable identifier. Preserve separate historical retention counts.
independent_blind: Select at most one student, one full-width learned candidate and one multilevel hybrid; evaluate baselines and numerical controls. Freeze identities and policy before generating blind scenes.
timing: Exploratory times do not select a winner. Repeated matched timing is a later independent qualification.
